interpretation: Proof-led static units on LinkedIn are the fastest-improving format/environment pairing for Builder audiences.
recommended_action: Make the proof-led LinkedIn static the default first-touch unit for new Verified Human Network segments.

interpretation: LinkedIn is the strongest environment for identifying and building repeat engagement from named accounts, particularly for proof-led and before/after carousels.
recommended_action: Prioritize LinkedIn for any variant designed to build an account-level engagement signal.

interpretation: Technical media consistently produces the deepest content progression in the portfolio, even at low reach — this environment rewards depth over hooks.
recommended_action: Evaluate technical media placements on progression and dwell signals, not click volume.

interpretation: AI community placements are replicating technical media's depth advantage while adding meaningfully more reach.
recommended_action: Treat AI Community as the scale environment for proof-led and before/after content once it's validated in technical media.

interpretation: Programmatic display is the clearest driver of rising high-intent behavior, especially in retargeting sequences that follow an earlier LinkedIn or technical-media touch.
recommended_action: Reserve programmatic display for retargeting rather than cold prospecting, and pair it with a comparison or proof landing page.

interpretation: Search is a small-volume but high-signal environment — comparison and verification queries are converting into the strongest intent behavior measured.
recommended_action: Fund dedicated comparison and verification-criteria landing pages before scaling search spend.

interpretation: Event surround placements are reliable reach builders around a known industry moment but do not yet produce deep engagement on their own.
recommended_action: Use event surround for awareness only and route attendees into a retargeting sequence afterward.

interpretation: Narrative-led statics extend event reach to Creator audiences but need a distinct retargeting follow-up to build deeper engagement.
recommended_action: Pair event-surround Creator reach with a before/after retargeting variant rather than a repeat static.
